interpretation: Each fold trains fresh models using only its prior base/meta periods; validation selects the strategy before that fold's test. Test state dates and test return dates are disjoint across folds for each seed. Later folds may use earlier test observations after they become historical data. Each fold resets to cash and omits the boundary-crossing return. Means and standard deviations describe fold returns, not a continuously held portfolio or independent-market confidence intervals.
